subject.title: feat: Add Anthropic server-side compaction API support

question: Should Anthropic-native compaction be exposed as model/run parameters, as part of the existing compaction provider seam, or as a narrower Anthropic provider-owned setting?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent public API shape crosses config compatibility, provider request payloads, session replay, and the broader Anthropic context-management tracker.

options.title: Provider-owned opt-in params
options.body: Add Anthropic-specific opt-in model/run params and docs while keeping local/pluggable compaction behavior unchanged by default.

options.title: Compaction provider integration
options.body: Route Anthropic native compaction through the existing compaction provider surface, accepting that the registry would stretch beyond summarize backends.

options.title: Wait for umbrella design
options.body: Keep this focused issue open but defer implementation until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/54041 settles context-management headers, memory/context editing, and security boundaries together.

recommendation.title: Provider-owned opt-in params
recommendation.body: Add Anthropic-specific opt-in model/run params and docs while keeping local/pluggable compaction behavior unchanged by default.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest visible review context for this issue and adjacent provider-compaction precedent.
